rules: A clause passes when its chapter is a number at or under the reader cutoff (the last chapter of the debut arc by default, every chapter when that arc is open) and it is not late, a late clause passing only for a reader who has finished the story; the line is the clauses from the first up to the first failure joined by a space, trailing clauses dropped until the line is 22 words or fewer, trailing punctuation dropped, and no line at all under six words or without a finite verb.
